singleDetailRows.title: Design system prompts
singleDetailRows.subtitle: Prompt primitives owned by the package

configure-commands: Provider configuration should be derived from declarative provider config.
- Parse existing files with structured parsers.
- Deep merge edits instead of replacing user-owned configuration.
- Keep CLI and SDK arguments in parity.
provider-boilerplate: Adding a provider should mean adding one provider file. Everything else should come from the provider config.
Avoid provider-specific branches in shared code paths.
markdown-reader: Render markdown plans with stable wrapping and predictable terminal styling.
The reader is a display surface, not a planning store.
design-system-prompts: Prompt primitives belong in the design-system package so CLI surfaces share one style.
Direct use of unrelated prompt libraries should stay out of consumers.
